subject.title: Request: delete stale plugin entries claw-pay-plugin (v0.27, v0.25) from Publisher Plugins

question: Should the currently visible `claw-pay-plugin` releases `0.2.7` and `0.2.6` be withdrawn, given that the requested `0.27` and `0.25` records are absent from the public API?
rationale: Withdrawing an executable autonomous-payment package changes artifact availability and trust state, while the reporter’s identifiers no longer match production; repository evidence cannot safely infer publisher intent.

options.title: Confirm live targets first
options.body: Ask the publisher to confirm `0.2.7` and `0.2.6`, then delete or revoke only the confirmed releases through the audited lifecycle path.

options.title: Leave current releases published
options.body: Take no destructive action because the live releases differ from the exact versions named in the request, pending an updated request from the publisher.

recommendation.title: Confirm live targets first
recommendation.body: Ask the publisher to confirm `0.2.7` and `0.2.6`, then delete or revoke only the confirmed releases through the audited lifecycle path.
